title: Vacancy Circular for Various Posts at IPC Purely on Contractual basis through Manpower Resource Outsourcing Services Providing Agency.
bodyHtml:
INDIAN PHARMACOPOEIA COMMISSION
(Ministry of Health & Family Welfare)
Government of India
Sector- 23, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad
Applications are invited for the following vacant posts purely on contract basis at Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), an Autonomous organization under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Ghaziabad, through Manpower Resource Outsourcing Services Providing Agency.
Details of Manpower Requirement
S. No. Post Salary No.
of Posts		 Qualification
1 Associate (Materiovigilance Associate ) 32,000.00 10 Graduation in Biomedical Engineering/Clinical Engineering OR Master’s in Pharmacy.
Good knowledge of computers.
Experience - Minimum 3 years experiance in analytical roles specializing in devices & diagnostics validation/evaluations.
2 Research Scientist
(Sr Materiovigilance Associate )		 40,000.00 2 Graduation in Biomedical Engineering/Clinical Engineering OR Master’s in Pharmacy.
Good knowledge of computers.
Experience - Minimum 5 years experiance in analytical roles specializing in devices & diagnostics validation/evaluations.
Period of engagement:
The tenure of contract will be for period of 1 year. However, in case the work and conduct of the staff is not found to be satisfactory during the contract tenure, the services may be terminated at any time without assigning any reason thereof.
General Instructions:

The competent authority reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies and reject/select/cancellation of all applications received without assigning any reason.
1. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. It is not obligatory on the part of IPC or Manpower Outsourcing Service Agency to call for interview every candidate who possesses the essential qualification. Preference may be given to the candidates who have desirable experience.
2. Experience may be relaxed at discretion of the Competent Authority
3. Interested candidates should submit their application online through Google Form with the following link https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSchLZ1cqGirpBu2SgKekWyF1vRN8RR4cHZ0zUkvcSTguNYymQ/viewform (opens in a new tab) available on IPC website www.ipc.gov.in. No other mode of submission of application form will be accepted. The last date for submitting the application form is 4th November 2020
